findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_resume, preview_resume · Private data: create_guest_context, tailor_resume, render_resume_template, preview_resume, finalize_resume, get_resume_document · Public sink: create_tailored_resume, analyze_resume_job, import_resume, analyze_job_offer, tailor_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_resume, preview_resume · Private data: create_guest_context, tailor_resume, render_resume_template, preview_resume, finalize_resume, get_resume_document · Public sink: create_tailored_resume, analyze_resume_job, import_resume, analyze_job_offer, tailor_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
